excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist, long blonde hair, tanned skin, wearing a white sun hat. Wears a light pink blouse worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts and pink hiking boots.
excavation_context.stage: Cleaving Layered Sandstone on a Coastal Lowland Badland

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_1, wearing her white sun hat, uses a steel hammer and chisel to carefully cleave open a block of tan-grey sandstone matrix out on an open coastal lowland hill slope. The split rock neatly exposes the massive, robust maxilla and serrated teeth of a Tyrannosaurus Rex skull. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
